test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

This win could __enhance__ to be a historic turning point in the fortunes of the team.
solution:
The correct answer is: **prove**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"prove"** means to demonstrate the truth or existence of something by evidence or argument. (साबित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist was able to prove his theory with substantial evidence.
 
 
 
• The correct word "prove" (साबित करना) implies that the win could demonstrate or establish itself as a historic turning point in the fortunes of the team.
 
 
• **Example:** This win could prove to be a historic turning point in the fortunes of the team.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **prove**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confirm** (पुष्टि करना): To establish the truth or correctness of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The tests confirm that she is pregnant.
 
 
 
• **Accomplish** (पूरा करना): To achieve or complete successfully.
 
 
• **Example:** They were able to accomplish their mission without any casualties.
 
 
 
• **Demonstrate** (प्रदर्शित करना): To show or make something clear.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher used a model to demonstrate how the heart pumps blood.
 
 

40:Tbd1,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
